title: Great Egg-spectations
start: Talk to the Easter Bunny in the Blooming Burrow.

ironman.t: Partial completion of Chef's Assistant (to obtain biscuits)

items.t: Sliced banana (obtained by picking a Banana Tree in Musa Point during the quest)
Nuts (can be purchased from the Pet Shops in Taverley or Yanille)
Grapes (can be purchased from the Culinaromancer's Chest)

Biscuits (can be made at level 32 Cooking with a pot of flour and pat of butter after Chef's Assistant, butter can be made at level 38 Cooking or purchased from the Culinaromancer's Chest or The Village Grocery)

recommended.t: Amulet of glory for quick teleport to Musa Point
Runes to cast the Teleport falador spell or access to the Falador lodestone
Mystical sand seed or sand seed for quick teleport to the Garden of Kharid

rewards.t: Emotes from previous Easter events (if not already unlocked)
Around the World in Eggty Days
rewards.l: Around the World in Eggty Days

rewards.t: Access to the factory line activity in the Blooming Burrow

steps.t: Talk to Easter Bunny in the northern area of the Blooming Burrow. [Chat: 1 Talk bout 'Great Egg-spectations'. › Accept]
Talk to Cocoa Bunny on the hill in the south-east.
Travel to Musa Point on Karamja.
Eavesdrop on the banoffee chocolate recipe on the table by Luthas.
Pick a banana from the banana tree and slice it if not done so already.
Travel to the dwarven mines, north of Falador, and climb-down the ladder into the mines.
Eavesdrop on the rocky road chocolate recipe on the table in Drogo's Mining Emporium.
Travel to the Garden of Kharid, north of Het's Oasis.
Eavesdrop on the fruit and nut chocolate recipe in the north-eastern hut.
Dry grapes on the washing line at Garden of Kharid.

sub.t: Note: grapes can't be dried on the washing line until you've eavesdropped the other 2 chocolate recipes.

steps.t: Buy some nuts from a pet shop.
Travel to Egg Plant in the Blooming Burrow.
Take from the sugar sacks.
Talk to Gooey Bunny to acquire marshmallows.
Cook the sugar into a bottle of caramel on a range. Any range works, but the range in Easter Bunny's house to the north-east is close to next step.
Talk to the Easter Bunny. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Great Egg-spectations'.]
Go back to the Egg Plant.

Complete the actions in the order listed. Be careful to completely finish the dialogue at each station before moving on to the next station. Interrupting the dialogue will require you to repeat the step.

sub.t: Mix chocolate at the mixing station.
Mould chocolate at the moulding station.
Foil chocolate at the foiling station. [Chat: any]

steps.t: Return to the Easter Bunny. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Great Egg-spectations'. › any]
Travel to the Lumbridge Market.
Talk to Cocoa Bunny while standing just north of the bank chest. [Chat: 1 › 1]

A cutscene ensues. Give the right samples to the patrons based on what they ask for. [Chat: 2 Offer fruit and nut chocolate. › 2 Offer a sample with less dried grapes in it. › 1 Offer banoffee chocolate.]
Return to the Blooming Burrow.
Talk to the Easter Bunny. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Great Egg-spectations'.]
Quest complete!
